string.name: c2_f2
string.value: You make me do all sorts of things.

string.name: c2_f4
string.value: Why don't you lie down first?

string.name: c3_s1
string.value: Why don't you come sit with me?

string.name: c3_s2
string.value: You should sit and relax, too.

string.name: c3_f3
string.value: I can't hear you! Speak LOUDER!

string.name: c4_s4
string.value: I will sit for you! You are scary and powerful!

string.name: c4_f1
string.value: I don't want to do it right now.

string.name: c4_f2
string.value: I'm not going to do anything right now.

string.name: c5_s2
string.value: Who do you think you are?

string.name: c5_f2
string.value: You're the one that should be punished!

string.name: c6_f1
string.value: Don't talk to me like that!

string.name: c6_f2
string.value: I said, don't order me around!

string.name: c6_f3
string.value: I don't even want to see your stupid face.

string.name: c7_s2
string.value: Would you please cut me some slack?

string.name: c7_f3
string.value: I said, mind your own business!

string.name: c7_f4
string.value: How dare you get angry at me?! I will never forgive you for this!

string.name: c8_s2
string.value: Can't you see my tears? Please, have a heart...

string.name: c8_f1
string.value: Have I ever smacked you before?

string.name: c8_f2
string.value: I can't take it anymore! AAAAAAAHHHH!

string.name: c10_f2
string.value: I may be quiet, but I haven't forgiven you.

string.name: c11_s2
string.value: If you really mean it, give me something to eat.

string.name: c11_s3
string.value: I accept, but understand that I don't feel the same way.

string.name: c11_f3
string.value: Don't do this right before I eat!

string.name: c11_f4
string.value: Why do you make me suffer?

string.name: c12_s1
string.value: So many fans, so little time to crush all their hearts.

string.name: c12_s3
string.value: Now I see you are just trying to be mean to me. Thank you!

string.name: c12_s4
string.value: That is the rudest thing you can say!

string.name: c13_f2
string.value: I'm not going to throw that away.

string.name: c14_s1
string.value: I'm trying, but nothing is coming out!

string.name: c14_s4
string.value: Don't talk to me! Can't you see that I'm concentrating?

string.name: c14_f1
string.value: Now is not a good time.

string.name: c14_f2
string.value: I'll pretend you didn't just say that.

string.name: c15_s3
string.value: My digestive system is in full gear.

string.name: c16_f2
string.value: You're the one who needs some sleep. See those bags under your eyes?

string.name: c17_s3
string.value: Okay, but only because I want to.

string.name: c17_s4
string.value: How can I sleep when I don't feel sleepy at all?

string.name: c17_f1
string.value: I don't want to sleep! Don't make me!

string.name: c17_f4
string.value: I've plenty of fire in me! I don't need sleep!

string.name: c18_s1
string.value: I sleep whenever I want. It has nothing to do with you.

string.name: c18_s2
string.value: I also sleep during the daytime.

string.name: c18_f4
string.value: Can't you see that my eyes are still WIDE open?

string.name: c19_s2
string.value: Who do you think you are, kid?

string.name: c19_s4
string.value: You want me to talk? There, I talked.

string.name: c19_f1
string.value: I don't want to talk right now.

string.name: c19_f2
string.value: How dare you try to have words with me...

string.name: c19_f4
string.value: You need to be quiet here!

string.name: c20_s1
string.value: You'd better feed me on time. Or I'll run away!

string.name: c20_s2
string.value: I guess having a big head doesn't mean that person's smart...

string.name: c20_s3
string.value: Can you defeat Zakum? I don't think you can...

string.name: c20_f2
string.value: I don't wanna talk right now! I'm in a bad mood!

string.name: c20_f3
string.value: Why don't you just keep...doing what you do?

string.value: Why are you always ordering me around?

string.name: c21_s3
string.value: Do you want to fight me?
